newsitem.title: USA: US corporate bond new issues on hold for Christmas.
newsitem.headline: US corporate bond new issues on hold for Christmas.

text.p: Corporate bond new issue activity will remain on hold as players head early in an abbreviated trading session ahead of the Christmas Day holiday, dealers said.
"There's absolutely nothing going on today," said one syndicate source. "Desks are thinly staffed...a lot of people have already begun their holiday."
The Public Securities Assciation has recommended an early close of 1400 EST/1900 GMT, before the holiday.
On Wednesday, the U.S. credit and financial markets will be closed in observance of the Christmas Day holiday.
